prompt: edge-api-1 (nginx 1.24) fronts the orders-api pool (3 nodes) at ~900 req/s. Since yesterday's change enabling upstream keepalive we see ~160 intermittent 502s/min (0.3%), almost all on POST /v1/orders; GETs look unaffected. The backend team swears the app is healthy. Find why keepalive broke POSTs and stop the 502s.

billing migrated to new instances in 10.40.2.0/24 at 09:10 and the old 10.30.1.0/24 hosts were terminated. The record billing.internal was updated before cutover, yet edge-bill-1 (nginx 1.26) now returns 502 on 100% of /billing requests and its error log shows connect() failures to 10.30.1.21. Restore billing traffic.

reports-edge-1 p99 TTFB for GET /reports/export climbed from 0.8s to 11s at 16:00; node_exporter shows /var at 98% disk util and 35% iowait. The reporting API's own p99 is steady at 0.9s, each export is ~180MB, ~40 run concurrently, mostly to field tablets on ~2MB/s links. Stop the disk thrash and fix export latency.

Support spike: uploads to POST /v2/attachments fail instantly for mobile app v9.2 users, the release that added video attachments up to 100MB. Edge nginx (upload-edge-1) returns 413 in under 5ms and the attachments service logs zero incoming requests for the failures -- about 18% of upload attempts affected. Make 100MB uploads work.

After adding 'limit_req zone=api rate=50r/s burst=100' on /search yesterday, p95 latency during spikes went from 120ms to 2.1s. The 429/503 counters read zero and search-api's own p95 is steady at 95ms. Spikes reach about 140 r/s for a few seconds. Restore spike latency without removing the rate limit.

api.acme.io moved behind the new CDN at 11:00; since then limit_req (zone keyed on $binary_remote_addr, rate=20r/s) returns 429 to about 40% of all traffic and support is flooded. The error log repeats 'limiting requests ... client: 151.101.64.10'. Total traffic is unchanged at ~3k r/s. Restore correct per-client rate limiting.

During tonight's 20:00 flash sale, edge-shop-2 (nginx 1.26, worker_processes 4, worker_connections 1024) began returning 500s at ~90/s; the LB reports ~4,500 concurrent clients on this box. Grafana's nginx panel shows only ~2,050 active connections, half of theoretical capacity. Diagnose and restore full capacity before the 21:00 drop.

All SSE clients on /api/events/live through stream-edge-1 (nginx 1.24) drop at exactly 60s and auto-reconnect, creating ~1,100 reconnects/min. Direct connections to the events service stay up for hours. We already set proxy_read_timeout 3600s for SSE last month, yet streams still die at 60s. Find the disconnect cause and fix it.

We enabled gzip on origin-web-1 last week expecting egress savings, but origin egress to the CDN is unchanged at ~1.9TB/day and mobile users still pull ~1.2MB JSON from /api/catalog. Static HTML from the same box compresses fine, and the CDN confirms it forwards Accept-Encoding untouched. Make API responses compress for CDN-forwarded traffic.

Since enabling proxy_cache for /assets/i18n/*.json on cdn-origin-1 this morning, roughly 35% of German users intermittently receive English bundles. The backend sets Content-Language and 'Vary: Accept-Language' correctly on every response, and cache hit ratio is 93%. Make the cache language-correct without disabling it.

After the 14:35 web deploy, Sentry shows ~700 events/min of 'Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token <' from chunk files like /static/js/chunk-7f3a91.js. The nginx error log on spa-edge-1 is clean and the access log shows HTTP 200 for those chunk URLs. Users on stale tabs stay broken until a hard refresh. Stop serving broken chunks.

Since payments moved behind an SNI-routing ingress at 13:05, edge-pay-2 (nginx 1.24, proxy_pass https://payments_pool) fails 100% of requests with 502; the error log shows 'SSL_do_handshake() failed ... sslv3 alert handshake failure while SSL handshaking to upstream'. The payments team says TLS is fine and shows passing openssl checks. Restore the TLS path to upstream.

Since 02:40, about 25% of checkouts through orders-edge-1 are slow: p99 is 4.2s against the usual 300ms, yet 5xx stays near zero. Upstream orders_pool has 4 servers with max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s. Kubernetes shows app-3's pod restarted 14 times tonight. Make checkout latency recover.

Search tier: nginx routes tenants with 'hash $arg_tenant' across 6 warm-cache nodes. At 09:20 we removed dead node search-4 from the upstream; since then cluster cache hit ratio fell from 88% to 64% and the backing DB runs at 14.4k QPS, three times the usual 4.8k. The latency SLO is burning. Recover the hit ratio.
